segments.text: The compost delivery has been delayed until Wednesday morning.
We still need three volunteers to move the bags beside the tool shed.
Please do not place compost directly around the young herb plants.
Mina will label the shared beds before the weekend planting session.
If heavy rain is forecast, the session will move to Sunday afternoon.
